en: A vintage postcard with a black and white photographic view of an industrial landscape with a river, a clustered group of warehouses, factories, and smoke stacks in the background. In the foreground is a white church with a prominent tower. The caption reads 'Skönviks sågverk och Timrå kyrka,' indicating these are the Skönvik sawmill and Timrå church. The reverse side of the postcard features handwritten text in Swedish, a Swedish stamp, and is addressed to a recipient in Avesta.
